_sobre: Partes no estilo TOEIC da prova final do Intermediate (pedido do Luis, 12/nov/2026). Montado por scripts/build-prova-toeic.mjs, que gera os áudios (scripts/provaintermediate01-dialogo.json → assets/audio/provaintermediate01/) e escreve as questões no intermediate_prova.html. Fotos: imagens das próprias aulas, sem custo novo.

fotos.alt: Um homem e uma mulher numa mesa de café com um laptop; lá fora, chove.
frases: They're sitting at a table with a laptop.
A man is closing his laptop.
A woman is pouring coffee into a cup.
They're walking in the rain.
fotos.explica: Os dois estão sentados à mesa com um laptop. Ninguém está fechando o laptop, servindo café ou andando na chuva: a chuva está do lado de fora.

fotos.alt: Um estúdio de podcast com dois microfones; atrás do vidro, uma sala de aula.
frases: A woman is speaking into a microphone.
A man is writing on a whiteboard.
Two people are recording a video outside.
The students are leaving the classroom.
fotos.explica: A mulher fala no microfone. A gravação é num estúdio (não lá fora) e os alunos estão sentados na sala, não saindo.

fotos.alt: Duas mulheres tomam café numa calçada de Lisboa; um bonde amarelo passa atrás delas.
frases: A tram is passing behind the women.
The women are getting on a tram.
A waiter is serving the coffee.
The café is closed.
fotos.explica: O bonde passa atrás delas. Elas estão sentadas tomando café, não entrando no bonde; não há garçom na cena e o café está aberto.

fotos.alt: Um homem coça a cabeça olhando uma mala aberta em cima da cama.
frases: A man is looking at an open suitcase.
A man is closing the window.
The suitcase is full of books.
He's sleeping on the bed.
fotos.explica: O homem olha para a mala aberta. A mala tem algumas roupas (não livros) e ele está acordado, não dormindo.

fotos.alt: Duas mulheres jantam num apartamento com fotos de família na parede.
frases: Pictures are hanging on the wall.
The women are washing the dishes.
A man is cooking dinner.
They're eating outside in a garden.
fotos.explica: Há fotos penduradas na parede. Elas estão jantando dentro de casa, não lavando louça nem num jardim, e não há homem cozinhando.

opcoes: In the room on the second floor.
respostas.explica: When pede um momento: At ten tomorrow morning. In the room… responderia Where; Yes… responderia uma pergunta de sim ou não.

respostas.pergunta: Have you booked the hotel yet?
opcoes: Yes, I booked it last week.
The hotel has a nice view.
respostas.explica: Have you … yet? pede sim ou não sobre algo feito: Yes, I booked it last week. A segunda repete hotel, mas não responde.

respostas.pergunta: How long have you worked here?
opcoes: It takes twenty minutes by bus.
I'm working on a new project.
respostas.explica: How long have you…? pede duração até hoje: For about five years. As outras falam de trajeto e de projeto.

respostas.pergunta: Would you like me to help you with the report?
respostas.explica: Uma oferta de ajuda se responde aceitando ou recusando: That would be great, thanks.

respostas.pergunta: Have you ever been to Portugal?
opcoes: No, but I'd love to go.
respostas.explica: Have you ever been…? pergunta sobre experiência: No, but I'd love to go.

respostas.pergunta: Why are you so tired today?
respostas.explica: Why pede um motivo: I've been sleeping badly. Repetir tired com Yes é a armadilha clássica.

falas.en: Hi, Daniel. Have you finished the sales report yet?
Not yet. I've been answering customer emails all morning.
The manager needs it by four o'clock.
Don't worry. I'll send it to her before lunch.

perguntas.q: What has the man been doing all morning?
perguntas.explica: Ele diz: I've been answering customer emails all morning.

perguntas.q: When will the man send the report?
perguntas.explica: Ele promete: I'll send it to her before lunch. Four o'clock é o prazo do gerente.

falas.en: Good evening. I'm checking in. My name is Paulo Lima.
Welcome, Mr. Lima. You booked a double room for three nights, right?
Actually, I changed it to two nights. I sent an email yesterday.
Oh, I see it now. Your room is on the fifth floor.

perguntas.q: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
perguntas.explica: Check in, room e floor: é a recepção de um hotel.

perguntas.q: How many nights will the man stay?
perguntas.explica: Ele mudou a reserva: I changed it to two nights. Three era a reserva antiga e five é o andar.

falas.en: Are you going to the team dinner on Friday?
I'd like to, but I'm flying to Recife that evening.
Oh, that's a shame. Is it a work trip?
No, I'm visiting my parents. It's my dad's birthday.

perguntas.q: Why can't the man go to the dinner?
perguntas.explica: Ele diz: I'm flying to Recife that evening.

perguntas.q: What is the purpose of the man's trip?
opts: To look for a new job.
perguntas.explica: No, I'm visiting my parents. It's my dad's birthday.

leituras.titulo: Subject: Our new office in Lisbon
leituras.texto:
Dear team,

I'm happy to announce that our new office in Lisbon has finally opened. Carla Mendes and two colleagues have been working there since February, and they have already signed contracts with four local clients.

Next month, we're going to hire three more people for the Lisbon team. If you are interested in working in Portugal for six months, please send an email to Human Resources before May 15.

Best regards,
Paula Torres, Director

perguntas.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To announce the opening of a new office.
To invite the team to a party.
To explain a change in salaries.
perguntas.explica: A primeira frase diz o assunto: our new office in Lisbon has finally opened.

perguntas.q: How long has Carla been working in Lisbon?
perguntas.explica: have been working there since February. Six months é o tempo da vaga nova.

opts: Write to Human Resources before May 15.
Visit the Lisbon office next month.
Sign a contract with a client.
perguntas.explica: please send an email to Human Resources before May 15.

leituras.alt: Duas mulheres acenam da janela de um bonde amarelo em Lisboa.
leituras.texto:
Discover the old town on our famous yellow tram!

Tours leave every day at 2 p.m. from Praça da Figueira and last two hours. Tickets: €25 for adults and €12 for children under 12. The price includes a pastel de nata at a traditional bakery.

Tours are not available on public holidays. Please book online at least one day in advance.

perguntas.q: How long does the tour last?
What is included in the ticket price?
opts: A taxi back to the hotel.
perguntas.explica: The price includes a pastel de nata at a traditional bakery.

perguntas.q: What is true about the tours?
opts: They must be booked at least one day before.
perguntas.explica: Please book online at least one day in advance. Saem uma vez por dia, criança paga €12 e não há passeio em feriado.
